entity.name: Axonome
entity.description: Axonome builds and maintains FairMind, an open-source agentic AI governance platform. FairMind is developed in public under the MIT licence, with signed releases and an archived DOI for each release.

projects.name: FairMind
projects.description: Open-source agentic AI governance. FairMind runs governance as workflows: agents collect evidence, run fairness, robustness, privacy and security evaluations and draft findings, and a person approves or rejects at every gate. Every step lands on a hash-chained ledger, and one evaluation run maps to every framework requirement it supports, across 51 frameworks including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and India's DPDP Act. A CLI, Python SDK, GitHub Action and MCP server bring the release gate into CI and coding agents.

channels.description: Bank transfer to Axonome. Account details are shared on request once funding is approved.

plans.name: Maintainer time
plans.description: Paid maintainer time for FairMind: reviewing contributions, fixing bugs, keeping evaluation engines and framework mappings current, and answering users.

plans.name: Infrastructure and security
plans.description: Hosting for the demo and documentation, CI capacity, deploying the sandboxed evaluation runner, and independent security reviews of the evaluation sandbox and evidence ledger.
